text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally come!
I'm definitely gonna clear my name from that last race right here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just sit back and relax, you hear?
Watch me take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! If your heart's already given up,
you won't even win the races you could've won!
